description:
Register a new Advocate in the DPYC community registry.

Advocates are community utility services that provide shared
infrastructure (e.g., OAuth2 callback collectors) but aren't
monetized Operators or certification Authorities.

The request must be signed with ``npub``'s own key (NIP-98): a
service registers itself, and no one can register an npub they do
not hold.

npub.description: Nostr npub of the Advocate service.

service_description.description: Short description of what the service does.
